title: PRESSER | Deuce Alexander - Postgame Presser vs Wofford (11-21-26)
text: stand here in the middle. >> How good did this one feel? >> Uh, it felt great to just get back out there and showcase my talents. Uh, you know, a little rough few uh past weeks, but felt good. >> Um, >> what were the last few weeks like like when you had some struggles and then kind of what were the conversations you had this week? Pete mentioned talking to you a little bit this week. I'm sure you've talked to some teammates and stuff as well. What was the general message you got from the people around you? >> Uh just uh keep my head on straight. U that the games don't define me. Everybody know and like what I know what I'm capable of doing. Just had to get my confidence back. Um but yeah, just great talks with my people. Uh my close circle and they really help me out. >> A couple of people made reference to, you know, they're not going to speak for whatever your decision is about your future. Where are you in terms of the decision-m process about what you're going to do next? uh just focused on Mississippi State and just putting out good product and finishing the season strong. >> Duce, you talked about the need to get your confidence back. What did that look like for you? >> Uh just trusting my work. Uh wasn't really like trusting my work. Um just working a lot behind the scenes just to get my confidence back. Um just a lot of long hours by myself and uh just staying in the building. It very helped me out a lot. just going into your second Egg Bowl now and potentially your last home game uh with Miss, how important is this game to you next week? Uh >> it's very important not only to me but u to the whole staff and like just everybody on the team and the fans. We all know it's a big game, big history, so it's very important to go out there and get this one. >> And with a lot of new faces, what experience can you take from last year's Egg Bowl to kind of teach some of the new guys about the importance of this game? >> I'm going to let Tom Luke do all the teaching. He does a great job uh letting everybody know how important this game is and how passionate he is about it. So, he'll do a great job on it, but I'll definitely give a little intel and let him know how it's going to be. >> Juice on that first touchdown. I think uh you decided you thought about doing one of your c patented celebrations, but you stopped. What was the thought process behind that one? >> Uh I don't know. Just kind of feel like I didn't really deserve to do it at the moment. Um it's been in my head a lot, but yeah, I just did a little pump fake. Yeah. Any other questions for Deuce? One more time. >> See if this is working or not. Still, um, Duce, for going into the final game of the year against Mississippi State, besides just the rivalry aspect about it, what does winning that game, you know, having backto-back wins, things like that, setting up for the bowl game do just for making sure that this season ends on the right note for the program? >> Yeah, man. It means a lot for us. Uh definitely um we all know the season didn't go how we wanted it to go, but um getting these last two uh will give us momentum going into the a little bit of confidence going into the bowl game. So yeah, this game is definitely important for us to win and then going into the bowl game. Got to get that one too. >> Obviously Trinidad just told us he's playing in that game. Does that help with your decision with that or is that still up in the air for you? >> I was probably I was going to play regardless. Yeah. Didn't really think about not playing. >> All right. Any questions for Duce? >> All right. Thanks. >> Thank you.
